items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Well, we became friends, and, of course, Don Frye, the pianist in that band, and I are very good friends.

ctx.x: Dickie Wells. There's another great guy, as a person and a musician -- great trombonist. I first met Dickie Wells when I was going to school in Ohio. What was -- in fact, he was one of the original members of a band out of Springfield, Ohio, just a short distance from Wilberforce, and there were two brothers that owned this particular band, and he played in -- and they were Cecil and Lloyd Scott. Cecil Scott was the leader of the band, and Lloyd Scott was -- I think he was the drummer. And Cecil played tenor…
